request.text: Here. I made it for a man who won't be fetching it now. Three hundred years of iron in my forge, and all I saved is a hammer. That blade's yours now. When it's dull you bring it to me. Don't you dare throw it away. I can build a hull. I've never built one that floats. Hold your hands to the fire. Cold hands drop blades.
request.voice_description: Native English, British, a plain working English voice. Male, 45-55. Excellent quality. Persona: a big, strong village blacksmith, a man of few words. Emotion: steady, gruff, kind underneath, with a dry, homely humour. A deep, broad, chesty voice, slow and plain, in short sentences; warm and fatherly when he looks after people.
